mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines for 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of the unemployment rate above 4.7% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, reflecting expectations of weakening labor market conditions and reduced corporate investment.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative during periods when UNRATE crosses above 4.7% with a sustained upward trend.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both GDPC1 (total demand) and HOUST (industrial production units) signals robust demand growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as market anticipates sustained economic expansion.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to be significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of concurrent GDPC1 and HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in the INDPRO supply index below 99.1 signals tight supply conditions, prompting market anticipation of price increases and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-positive during periods when INDPRO drops below 99.1 without subsequent price surges.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5.24% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher interest rates reduce discounted cash flows for equities.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to be significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of sustained FEDFUNDS increases above 5.24%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent low unemployment (UNRATE below 4.7%) and high federal funds rates (above 5.24%) create a contractionary labor market environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate investment.
regime_hint: tight labor market with high rates
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative during periods when UNRATE is below 4.7 and FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.24%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in total demand (GDPC1) coupled with a decline in supply (INDPRO) creates upward pressure on prices, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as market anticipates inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to be significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of concurrent GDPC1 increases and INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by CPIAUCSL inflation below 2% and FEDFUNDS rates below 4%, S&P 500 forward returns are positively influenced over the next 60 trading days as markets anticipate prolonged growth.
candidate_trigger: in late-cycle expansion regime with CPIAUCSL < 2% and FEDFUNDS < 4%
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to be significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during the specified regime conditions over 60 days.
